title: Rare Ancient Debris
description: This datapack makes ancient debris generate less, which makes it rarer.
body:
![Rarer Ancient Debris!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a7cba643ded155edc228560c44371ea3f2215a02.png)

**🤔 About**

Have you ever wanted to make your world/server a little harder? Maybe add a bit of a grind?
Or maybe your armor and tools don't feel so special anymore? This datapack helps with that! It makes ancient debris rarer, so what are the features you might ask?

 **-** Makes ancient debris generate in smaller groups.
 **-** Makes ancient debris generate less.
 **-** Makes you game more enjoyable ;)

**🖥 Compatibility**

For now the datapack is only avalible for **1.21.4**
